intro: CYB 115 Lab Table of Contents and Command List
Jinzhou Hao  |  Exam reference  |  Labs 1 to 9 and 11 to 19

Each lab section appears once with its topics, commands, tools, and paths together. Use Ctrl+F to search a topic, command, filename, or section number. Uppercase placeholders such as FILE, USERNAME, and VM_IP require actual values. ~ means the user home directory; / means the filesystem root.

rows.en: Windows screenshots and file browsing. Snipping Tool; File Explorer; desktop icons; web search screenshots.
rows.zh: Windows 截图与文件浏览。截图工具（Snipping Tool）；文件资源管理器；桌面图标；网页搜索截图。

rows.en: Network registries and IP lookup. ARIN: look up IP address ownership and registration information.
rows.zh: 网络注册机构与 IP 查询。ARIN：查询 IP 地址的所有权和注册信息。

rows.en: Find the Windows IP address. Identify the computer IP address and capture the result.
rows.zh: 查找 Windows IP 地址。识别计算机的 IP 地址并截图记录结果。

rows.en: Ubuntu VM setup and host resources. Task Manager > Performance > Memory; This PC > drive space; VMware > Create a New Virtual Machine; select Ubuntu ISO; review VM hardware.
rows.zh: Ubuntu 虚拟机设置与主机资源。任务管理器 > 性能 > 内存；此电脑 > 驱动器空间；VMware > 创建新虚拟机；选择 Ubuntu ISO；检查虚拟机硬件。

rows.en: Ubuntu memory disk and IP information. free -h; df -h; ip a; System Monitor.
rows.zh: Ubuntu 内存、磁盘和 IP 信息。free -h；df -h；ip a；系统监视器（System Monitor）。

rows.en: Windows IP configuration. cmd; ipconfig. Identify adapter IP addresses and the default gateway.
rows.zh: Windows IP 配置。cmd；ipconfig。识别适配器的 IP 地址和默认网关。

rows.en: Host and VM connectivity. ping IP_ADDRESS from Windows and Ubuntu; replace IP_ADDRESS with the target address.
rows.zh: 主机与虚拟机连通性。在 Windows 和 Ubuntu 中运行 ping IP_ADDRESS；用目标地址替换 IP_ADDRESS。

rows.en: Basic Ubuntu terminal commands. whoami; hostname; ip address / ip a; date; history; clear.
rows.zh: Ubuntu 终端基本命令。whoami；hostname；ip address / ip a；date；history；clear。

rows.en: NAT and host only networking. VMware > VM > Settings > Network Adapter; ip a; ping IP_ADDRESS; ping 8.8.8.8; Ctrl+C stops ping.
rows.zh: NAT 与仅主机网络。VMware > VM > Settings > Network Adapter；ip a；ping IP_ADDRESS；ping 8.8.8.8；Ctrl+C 停止 ping。

rows.en: GUI file management and full paths. Files and Text Editor: create folders and a text file, move the file, and record its before/after paths.
rows.zh: 图形界面文件管理与完整路径。在 Files 和 Text Editor 中创建文件夹与文本文件，移动文件，记录移动前后的路径。

rows.en: Terminal directory navigation. pwd; ls -ll; cd Desktop; cd /etc. Linux paths are case-sensitive.
rows.zh: 终端目录导航。pwd；ls -ll；cd Desktop；cd /etc。Linux 路径区分大小写。

rows.en: Read other directories and files. cd ~ / cd; ls; ls /; ls /etc; cat /etc/timezone. Listing another directory does not change the working directory.
rows.zh: 读取其他目录和文件。cd ~ / cd；ls；ls /；ls /etc；cat /etc/timezone。列出其他目录不会改变当前工作目录。

rows.en: IP address and empty file creation. ip addr show / ip a; touch FILE; ls.
rows.zh: IP 地址与创建空文件。ip addr show / ip a；touch FILE；ls。

rows.en: Create and remove files and directories. cd ~; mkdir green; ls; touch pink; rm pink. Recursive deletion: rm -r; forced recursive deletion: rm -rf. Check the target path before deletion.
rows.zh: 创建和删除文件及目录。cd ~；mkdir green；ls；touch pink；rm pink。递归删除：rm -r；强制递归删除：rm -rf。删除前检查目标路径。

rows.en: Move and copy files. touch ~/example1.txt; mv ~/example1.txt ~/green/; cp ~/example2.txt ~/green/; ls ~/green/; Tab completion.
rows.zh: 移动与复制文件。touch ~/example1.txt；mv ~/example1.txt ~/green/；cp ~/example2.txt ~/green/；ls ~/green/；Tab 自动补全。

rows.en: Nano editing and text display. nano movie_quote.txt; cat ~/movie_quote.txt; echo "hello world" > movie_quote.txt. Nano: Ctrl+O save, Enter confirm, Ctrl+X exit, Ctrl+W search, Ctrl+K cut, Ctrl+U paste.
rows.zh: Nano 编辑与文本显示。nano movie_quote.txt；cat ~/movie_quote.txt；echo "hello world" > movie_quote.txt。Nano：Ctrl+O 保存，Enter 确认，Ctrl+X 退出，Ctrl+W 搜索，Ctrl+K 剪切，Ctrl+U 粘贴。

rows.en: Append text and complete filenames. echo hello >> example.txt; cat example.txt; Tab completes matching filenames.
rows.zh: 追加文本与补全文件名。echo hello >> example.txt；cat example.txt；Tab 补全匹配的文件名。

rows.en: Elevated permissions for protected files. nano /file vs. sudo nano /file; rm /file vs. sudo rm /file. Compare permission-denied and successful results.
rows.zh: 以提升的权限操作受保护文件。对比 nano /file 与 sudo nano /file；rm /file 与 sudo rm /file。比较权限被拒绝和成功执行的结果。

rows.en: Root shell and protected directories. sudo su -; mkdir /home/NAME; ls /home/; exit; rmdir /home/NAME; sudo rmdir /home/NAME. rmdir removes empty directories.
rows.zh: Root shell 与受保护目录。sudo su -；mkdir /home/NAME；ls /home/；exit；rmdir /home/NAME；sudo rmdir /home/NAME。rmdir 删除空目录。

rows.en: Install and test Apache. sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install apache2; ip addr show; browse http://localhost and http://VM_IP.
rows.zh: 安装与测试 Apache。sudo apt-get update；sudo apt-get install apache2；ip addr show；访问 http://localhost 和 http://VM_IP。

rows.en: Replace the Apache default web page. ip a; cp; rm; touch index.html; sudo nano index.html; cat index.html. Back up, replace, and test the page.
rows.zh: 替换 Apache 默认网页。ip a；cp；rm；touch index.html；sudo nano index.html；cat index.html。备份、替换并测试网页。

rows.en: Apache on port 8080. Edit /etc/apache2/ports.conf with sudo nano ports.conf from its directory; add Listen 8080; restart Apache; browse http://VM_IP:8080.
rows.zh: 让 Apache 使用 8080 端口。在 /etc/apache2/ 目录中用 sudo nano ports.conf 编辑 /etc/apache2/ports.conf；添加 Listen 8080；重启 Apache；访问 http://VM_IP:8080。

rows.en: Start SSH and connect with PuTTY. sudo systemctl status ssh; sudo systemctl start ssh; ip a; PuTTY > SSH > VM IP address.
rows.zh: 启动 SSH 并使用 PuTTY 连接。sudo systemctl status ssh；sudo systemctl start ssh；ip a；PuTTY > SSH > 虚拟机 IP 地址。

rows.en: Remote terminal and Linux filesystem. PuTTY: ls; cd; cat; touch; pwd; nano Jinzhou_Hao.txt. Explore /, /boot, /var, /etc, /mnt, /home; inspect /etc/timezone, /etc/fstab, and /boot/grub/grub.cfg.
rows.zh: 远程终端与 Linux 文件系统。PuTTY：ls；cd；cat；touch；pwd；nano Jinzhou_Hao.txt。探索 /、/boot、/var、/etc、/mnt、/home；检查 /etc/timezone、/etc/fstab 和 /boot/grub/grub.cfg。

rows.en: Local hostname mapping and name resolution. Configure a local IP-to-name mapping; ping spaceship to test hostname resolution. Search this section for the Linux hosts-file exercise.
rows.zh: 本地主机名映射与名称解析。配置本地 IP 到名称的映射；运行 ping spaceship 测试主机名解析。Linux hosts 文件练习归于本节。

rows.en: Users and password hashes. sudo adduser userone; sudo adduser usertwo; inspect /etc/shadow and compare the stored hashes.
rows.zh: 用户与密码哈希。sudo adduser userone；sudo adduser usertwo；检查 /etc/shadow 并比较保存的哈希值。

rows.en: Linux file permissions and ownership. Change read/write permissions, test editing in Nano, change ownership with chown, and test access again. Exact permission command arguments: see the original screenshots.
rows.zh: Linux 文件权限与所有权。修改读写权限，测试 Nano 编辑，用 chown 修改所有权，再次测试访问。确切的权限命令参数请查看原始截图。

rows.en: Redirection pipes tee and whois installation. ip addr > ipinfo.txt; ls -l /usr/bin > ls-output.txt; cat /etc/timezone >> tz.txt; COMMAND | tee FILE. > replaces; >> appends; tee displays and saves. Includes saving whois installation output to installresults.txt.
rows.zh: 重定向、管道、tee 与 whois 安装。ip addr > ipinfo.txt；ls -l /usr/bin > ls-output.txt；cat /etc/timezone >> tz.txt；COMMAND | tee FILE。> 覆盖；>> 追加；tee 同时显示和保存。包括将 whois 安装输出保存到 installresults.txt。

rows.en: Job control and foreground background processes. Ping output grows as results are appended to a file; pause/suspend and resume a process; compare foreground/background behavior. Exact job-control commands: see the original screenshots.
rows.zh: 作业控制与前台、后台进程。将 ping 输出追加到文件时，文件内容持续增加；暂停或挂起进程，再恢复；比较前台与后台行为。确切的作业控制命令请查看原始截图。

rows.en: Create users and change passwords. sudo adduser USERNAME; sudo passwd USERNAME. Use the same account name in both commands.
rows.zh: 创建用户与修改密码。sudo adduser USERNAME；sudo passwd USERNAME。两条命令使用同一个账户名。

rows.en: Remote login and file access. PuTTY: sign in to the remote account; navigate to the file; nano goofy.txt.
rows.zh: 远程登录与文件访问。PuTTY：登录远程账户；导航到目标文件；nano goofy.txt。

rows.en: Enable UFW and allow web access. sudo ufw enable; sudo ufw allow 80; compare web access before and after allowing port 80.
rows.zh: 启用 UFW 并允许网页访问。sudo ufw enable；sudo ufw allow 80；比较放行 80 端口前后的网页访问情况。

rows.en: Apache installation and service checks. sudo apt update; sudo apt install apache2; sudo systemctl status apache2; ip addr show; verify SSH is running; test the Apache page.
rows.zh: Apache 安装与服务检查。sudo apt update；sudo apt install apache2；sudo systemctl status apache2；ip addr show；确认 SSH 已运行；测试 Apache 网页。

rows.en: Rename the default Apache page. PuTTY over SSH port 22; cd /var/www/html; sudo mv index.html olddefault.html; browse http://VM_IP/olddefault.html.
rows.zh: 重命名 Apache 默认网页。通过 SSH 22 端口使用 PuTTY；cd /var/www/html；sudo mv index.html olddefault.html；访问 http://VM_IP/olddefault.html。

rows.en: Read and copy remote HTML. PuTTY; cd /pluto; ls; cat index.html; nano. Copy the remote HTML into the local Apache page and test it in a browser.
rows.zh: 读取与复制远程 HTML。PuTTY；cd /pluto；ls；cat index.html；nano。将远程 HTML 复制到本地 Apache 网页，并在浏览器测试。

rows.en: Apache custom port 1961. sudo nano /etc/apache2/ports.conf; set Listen 1961; sudo nano /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf; set virtual-host port 1961; sudo systemctl restart apache2; browse http://VM_IP:1961.
rows.zh: Apache 自定义 1961 端口。sudo nano /etc/apache2/ports.conf；设置 Listen 1961；sudo nano /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf；把虚拟主机端口设为 1961；sudo systemctl restart apache2；访问 http://VM_IP:1961。

rows.en: UFW rules for SSH and custom HTTP. Allow incoming ports 22 and 1961; sudo ufw enable; sudo ufw status verbose; test http://VM_IP:1961.
rows.zh: UFW 的 SSH 与自定义 HTTP 规则。允许入站端口 22 和 1961；sudo ufw enable；sudo ufw status verbose；测试 http://VM_IP:1961。

rows.en: Windows VM connection. Connect to the Windows VM, authenticate, and reach the desktop.
rows.zh: 连接 Windows 虚拟机。连接 Windows VM，完成身份验证并进入桌面。

rows.en: Windows and Linux command comparison. Run as administrator; cd; dir; mkdir; notepad; ipconfig /all; winget. Linux comparison terms: sudo, ls, cp, mv, cat, nano, ip addr, apt-get. Check the shell: PowerShell aliases and Command Prompt commands differ.
rows.zh: Windows 与 Linux 命令比较。以管理员身份运行；cd；dir；mkdir；notepad；ipconfig /all；winget。Linux 对照术语：sudo、ls、cp、mv、cat、nano、ip addr、apt-get。注意所用 shell：PowerShell 别名与命令提示符命令有所不同。

rows.en: Windows hosts file. Administrator shell: cd \Windows\System32\drivers\etc; dir; edit hosts in Notepad; Ctrl+S; ping spaceship.
rows.zh: Windows hosts 文件。管理员 shell：cd \Windows\System32\drivers\etc；dir；使用记事本编辑 hosts；Ctrl+S；ping spaceship。

rows.en: Remote Desktop RDP connection. Settings > System > Remote Desktop > Enable; ipconfig; Remote Desktop Connection > VM IP > More choices > Use a different account.
rows.zh: 远程桌面 RDP 连接。设置 > 系统 > 远程桌面 > 启用；ipconfig；远程桌面连接 > 虚拟机 IP > 更多选项 > 使用其他账户。

rows.en: Network share and installer copy. VMware network adapter > NAT; ipconfig; Run > \\SERVER\SHARE; authenticate; copy MBSetup-4.4.exe to the local desktop.
rows.zh: 网络共享与复制安装程序。VMware 网络适配器 > NAT；ipconfig；运行 > \\SERVER\SHARE；身份验证；复制 MBSetup-4.4.exe 到本地桌面。

rows.en: Malwarebytes installation. Run the copied installer and explore malware removal and protection features.
rows.zh: 安装 Malwarebytes。运行复制的安装程序，探索恶意软件清除与防护功能。

rows.en: Install and test IIS. Control Panel > Programs and Features > Turn Windows features on or off > Internet Information Services; browse http://VM_IP.
rows.zh: 安装与测试 IIS。控制面板 > 程序和功能 > 启用或关闭 Windows 功能 > Internet Information Services；访问 http://VM_IP。

rows.en: Stop IIS through Services. Windows Tools > Services > World Wide Web Publishing Service > Stop; refresh the website and observe failure.
rows.zh: 通过服务停止 IIS。Windows 工具 > 服务 > World Wide Web Publishing Service > 停止；刷新网站并观察访问失败。

rows.en: IIS Manager and service control. Start World Wide Web Publishing Service; open IIS Manager; stop the web server; refresh Services with F5; start it again.
rows.zh: IIS 管理器与服务控制。启动 World Wide Web Publishing Service；打开 IIS 管理器；停止 Web 服务器；按 F5 刷新服务列表；再次启动。

rows.en: Windows service review. Services > Properties: compare Status and Startup type; inspect Task Scheduler and review disabled or stopped services.
rows.zh: Windows 服务检查。服务 > 属性：比较状态（Status）和启动类型（Startup type）；检查任务计划程序并查看已禁用或停止的服务。

rows.en: Netlogon DNS Client and HTTP firewall rule. Service properties: Netlogon and DNS Client. Firewall: Windows Defender Firewall > Advanced settings > Inbound Rules > World Wide Web Services (HTTP Traffic-In) > Properties; inspect the port and test Block the connection. Both source headings are labelled 13E.
rows.zh: Netlogon、DNS Client 与 HTTP 防火墙规则。查看 Netlogon 和 DNS Client 的服务属性。防火墙：Windows Defender 防火墙 > 高级设置 > 入站规则 > World Wide Web Services (HTTP Traffic-In) > 属性；检查端口并测试“阻止连接”。两个原始标题均标为 13E。

rows.en: IIS custom port and firewall. IIS Manager > Sites > Default Web Site > Bindings > HTTP port 8080; Firewall > Inbound Rules > New Rule > Port > TCP 8080 > Allow; test http://VM_IP:8080.
rows.zh: IIS 自定义端口与防火墙。IIS 管理器 > 站点 > Default Web Site > 绑定 > HTTP 端口 8080；防火墙 > 入站规则 > 新建规则 > 端口 > TCP 8080 > 允许；测试 http://VM_IP:8080。

rows.en: Drive file systems NTFS and properties. File Explorer > drive Properties: compare filesystem, drive type, and available tabs. C: and the examined S: network drive showed NTFS; distinguish local, removable, and network drives.
rows.zh: 驱动器文件系统、NTFS 与属性。文件资源管理器 > 驱动器属性：比较文件系统、驱动器类型和可用选项卡。C: 和所检查的 S: 网络驱动器都显示 NTFS；区分本地、可移动和网络驱动器。

rows.en: NTFS group permissions. Create C:\rose; Properties > Security; compare Authenticated Users, SYSTEM, Administrators, and Users.
rows.zh: NTFS 组权限。创建 C:\rose；属性 > 安全；比较 Authenticated Users、SYSTEM、Administrators 和 Users。

rows.en: Effective Access. C:\rose > Properties > Security > Advanced > Effective Access > Select a user > View effective access.
rows.zh: 有效访问。C:\rose > 属性 > 安全 > 高级 > 有效访问 > 选择用户 > 查看有效访问。

rows.en: Disable inheritance and restore access. Properties > Security > Advanced > Disable inheritance > remove inherited permissions; test access; restore the required permissions and test again.
rows.zh: 禁用继承与恢复访问。属性 > 安全 > 高级 > 禁用继承 > 删除继承的权限；测试访问；恢复所需权限并再次测试。

rows.en: Local users and special permissions. Computer Management > Local Users and Groups > Users > New User; create Jinzhou; configure create/delete allow and deny entries for analyst and Jinzhou in C:\rose\Jinzhou.
rows.zh: 本地用户与特殊权限。计算机管理 > 本地用户和组 > 用户 > 新用户；创建 Jinzhou；在 C:\rose\Jinzhou 中为 analyst 和 Jinzhou 配置创建和删除的允许与拒绝条目。

rows.en: Compare inherited file permissions. Create files in C:\rose and its subfolder; compare Security entries and inherited account-specific permissions.
rows.zh: 比较继承的文件权限。在 C:\rose 及其子文件夹中创建文件；比较安全条目和继承的特定账户权限。

rows.en: Ownership and access recovery. Create Snoopy and C:\doghouse; file Properties > Security > Advanced > change Owner; remove inherited permissions; test denial; restore ownership and grant access.
rows.zh: 所有权与访问恢复。创建 Snoopy 和 C:\doghouse；文件属性 > 安全 > 高级 > 更改所有者；删除继承权限；测试访问被拒绝；恢复所有权并授予访问权限。

rows.en: Read only network sharing. Folder Properties > Sharing > Advanced Sharing > Share this folder > Permissions > Everyone: Read; open \\VM_IP\Lab-15_SharingFile; compare copying out with copying in.
rows.zh: 只读网络共享。文件夹属性 > 共享 > 高级共享 > 共享此文件夹 > 权限 > Everyone：读取；打开 \\VM_IP\Lab-15_SharingFile；比较复制出去与复制进去。

rows.en: Share permissions and NTFS permissions. Security > Users: Full Control; Advanced Sharing > Everyone: Read; open \\VM_IP\SHARE; copying out works, while network writes/renames are restricted by the share permission.
rows.zh: 共享权限与 NTFS 权限。安全 > Users：完全控制；高级共享 > Everyone：读取；打开 \\VM_IP\SHARE；允许复制出去，而网络写入与重命名受共享权限限制。

rows.en: Administrative shares. Computer Management > Shared Folders > Shares; inspect C$ and ADMIN$; open \\VM_IP\C$ with an administrator account; test file operations.
rows.zh: 管理共享。计算机管理 > 共享文件夹 > 共享；检查 C$ 和 ADMIN$；使用管理员账户打开 \\VM_IP\C$；测试文件操作。

rows.en: Registry startup entry backup and restore. regedit > HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run; Export; add String Value NotepadLauncher = C:\Windows\System32\Notepad.exe; restart/test; delete the added value; merge the backup.
rows.zh: 注册表启动项的备份与恢复。regedit > HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run；导出；添加字符串值 NotepadLauncher = C:\Windows\System32\Notepad.exe；重启并测试；删除新增值；合并备份。

rows.en: Windows Features time zone and printers. Windows Features > Telnet Client; compare Control Panel and Settings time-zone controls; Printers & scanners > Microsoft Print to PDF > Set as default.
rows.zh: Windows 功能、时区与打印机。Windows 功能 > Telnet Client；比较控制面板与设置中的时区选项；打印机和扫描仪 > Microsoft Print to PDF > 设为默认。

rows.en: Bing search registry setting. regedit > HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer; DWORD DisableSearchBoxSuggestions = 1; restart/test Start search.
rows.zh: Bing 搜索注册表设置。regedit > HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer；DWORD DisableSearchBoxSuggestions = 1；重启并测试开始菜单搜索。

rows.en: Document metadata. Rime.docx > Properties > Details; inspect author, last saved by, creation/save times, and content type.
rows.zh: 文档元数据。Rime.docx > 属性 > 详细信息；检查作者、最后保存者、创建和保存时间以及内容类型。

rows.en: PDF inspection in HxD. Extract the lab archive; open intro-linux.pdf in HxD; inspect hexadecimal bytes, decoded text, and PDF header; distinguish file corruption from encryption.
rows.zh: 使用 HxD 检查 PDF。解压实验压缩包；在 HxD 打开 intro-linux.pdf；检查十六进制字节、解码文本和 PDF 文件头；区分文件损坏与加密。

rows.en: Word inspection and encryption. Open The first rule.doc in HxD and Word; Word > File > Info > Protect Document > Encrypt with Password; compare the file bytes before and after encryption.
rows.zh: Word 文件检查与加密。在 HxD 和 Word 中打开 The first rule.doc；Word > 文件 > 信息 > 保护文档 > 用密码进行加密；比较加密前后的文件字节。

rows.en: Password protected archives. 7-Zip: archive Grand Canyon.txt as 7z with AES-256 and ZIP with ZipCrypto; compare extraction and password prompts in File Explorer.
rows.zh: 密码保护的压缩包。7-Zip：将 Grand Canyon.txt 分别用 AES-256 加密为 7z、用 ZipCrypto 加密为 ZIP；比较文件资源管理器中的解压与密码提示。

rows.en: VeraCrypt encrypted container. Create a 500 MB container with AES and FAT; set a password; mount as X:; create files/folders; Unmount All.
rows.zh: VeraCrypt 加密容器。创建使用 AES 和 FAT 的 500 MB 容器；设置密码；挂载为 X:；创建文件和文件夹；Unmount All（全部卸载）。

rows.en: Text hashing and capitalization. HashCalc > Text string > MD5 and SHA1; compare bulldog with Bulldog.
rows.zh: 文本哈希与大小写。HashCalc > Text string > MD5 和 SHA1；比较 bulldog 与 Bulldog。

rows.en: Compare file hashes. HashCalc and PowerShell: Get-FileHash "FILE" -Algorithm SHA1; compare original intro-linux.pdf with FileA and FileB.
rows.zh: 比较文件哈希。HashCalc 与 PowerShell：Get-FileHash "FILE" -Algorithm SHA1；比较原始 intro-linux.pdf 与 FileA、FileB。

rows.en: File transfer integrity. sudo systemctl status ssh; sudo systemctl enable --now ssh; ip a; WinSCP > SCP > port 22; transfer to /home/ubuntu; shasum intro-linux.pdf; compare hashes.
rows.zh: 文件传输完整性。sudo systemctl status ssh；sudo systemctl enable --now ssh；ip a；WinSCP > SCP > 22 端口；传输到 /home/ubuntu；shasum intro-linux.pdf；比较哈希值。

rows.en: Verify a downloaded file. PowerShell: Get-FileHash "HxDSetup.zip" -Algorithm SHA1; repeat with -Algorithm SHA512; compare complete hashes with the published values.
rows.zh: 验证下载文件。PowerShell：Get-FileHash "HxDSetup.zip" -Algorithm SHA1；再使用 -Algorithm SHA512；将完整哈希值与发布的值比较。

rows.en: Telnet plaintext and SSH encryption in Wireshark. sudo apt update; sudo apt-get install telnetd openssh-server; sudo nano /etc/inetd.conf; sudo systemctl restart inetd; sudo systemctl status inetd; sudo systemctl start ssh. PuTTY: compare Telnet 23 and SSH 22 using pwd, ls, cat /etc/timezone. Wireshark: tcp.port == 22; Follow > TCP Stream; compare readable credentials/commands with encrypted session data.
rows.zh: Wireshark 中的 Telnet 明文与 SSH 加密。sudo apt update；sudo apt-get install telnetd openssh-server；sudo nano /etc/inetd.conf；sudo systemctl restart inetd；sudo systemctl status inetd；sudo systemctl start ssh。PuTTY：使用 pwd、ls、cat /etc/timezone 比较 Telnet 23 和 SSH 22。Wireshark：tcp.port == 22；Follow > TCP Stream；比较可读的凭据、命令与加密会话数据。

rows.en: SMB file transfer and image recovery. Folder Properties > Sharing; Run > \\VM_IP; copy an image to the share during capture; Wireshark > File > Export Objects > SMB > Save.
rows.zh: SMB 文件传输与图片恢复。文件夹属性 > 共享；运行 > \\VM_IP；在捕获流量期间复制图片到共享；Wireshark > File > Export Objects > SMB > Save。

rows.en: HTTP file recovery from PCAP. Open the supplied PCAP in Wireshark; display filter: http; File > Export Objects > HTTP; select and save the image.
rows.zh: 从 PCAP 恢复 HTTP 文件。在 Wireshark 打开提供的 PCAP；显示过滤器：http；File > Export Objects > HTTP；选择并保存图片。

introZh: CYB 115 实验目录与命令列表
Jinzhou Hao（金洲）｜考试参考｜实验 1–9 和 11–19
每个实验小节仅列出一次，集中整理主题、命令、工具和路径。可使用 Ctrl+F 搜索主题、命令、文件名或章节编号。FILE、USERNAME、VM_IP 等大写占位符需要替换为实际值。~ 表示用户主目录；/ 表示文件系统根目录。
